guard/30386.htm.text: Guard Luis: Somewhere in that wide field that stretches out before me, the demon Beleth lies asleep. I heard that the reason the south of Gludio became the Wasteland and the insects and spiders grew monstrously large is because Beleth breathes out foul magic as he lies sealed underground. Recently,…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30386-1.htm.text: Guard Luis: Beleth is a demon that led the legions of the undead, and attempted to make an eternal empire of darkness in this land. However, the wise men of the Ivory Tower and the Elven Mystics joined forces, and with their powers sealed him underground. Some people say that Beleth was originally …

guard/30386-2.htm.text: Guard Luis: They are ants that have grown huge because of the magic forces that Beleth breathes out. They have dug a great cave in the middle of the crude Wasteland and live in a large colony. Sometimes foreigners fall into the Ant Nest and become their prey. If you're going out into the Wasteland,…

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-01.htm.text: Guard Luis: I've been looking for someone like you. I trust you've seen the havoc wrought throughout Gludio Territory. It was enough to have Ol Mahum Stragglers and Turek Orcs bothering us. Now the lizardmen from the south! The highway of the southern shoreline that leads to Giran has seen frequent…

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-02.htm.text: Guard Luis: Your face is unfamiliar. You must be a traveler. I trust you've seen the havoc wrought throughout Gludio Territory? It was enough to have Ol Mahum stragglers and Turek Orcs bothering us... Now the lizardmen from the south! The highway of the southern shoreline that leads to Giran has se…

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-05.html.text: Guard Luis: Have you driven them off yet? The raids continue. Perhaps you should keep at it. (Collect 100 Feather Ornaments.)

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-04.html.text: Guard Luis: Thanks to your help, the southern shoreline road is much safer! Let me see the Feather Ornaments. Hmm... this one's odd. This is a very ominous tooth, not a normal Langk Lizardman decoration. There's something sinister here. Can you take this tooth to Magister Iris of Einhasad Temple?

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-08.html.text: Guard Luis: You haven't been to Magister Iris yet? This is very important. Please go quickly and show her the tooth. She's at the Einhasad temple in the square of the northern part of the village.

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-03.htm.text: Guard Luis: Many thanks. The Langk Lizardman tribe used to keep to themselves on the southern shoreline, hunting and looting. Our scouts tell us that they've become organized and pose a serious threat! Some of their warriors are said to possess incredible new powers! We need your help clearing the …

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-06.html.text: Guard Luis: Thank you! We're indebted to Magister Iris for her help. I'm guessing from the pattern engraved on the tooth that it's a magic symbol. Show it to her. She's at the Einhasad Temple next to the square in the northern part of the village. Now hurry!

Q00038_DragonFangs/30386-07.html.text: Guard Luis: Are you done with the subjugation already? The attacks on the southern coast road continue... Could there be some kind of misunderstanding? You should work a bit harder. The safety of our residents is our utmost priority! (Collect 100 warrior's feather accessories.)
